page.overview:
Who is Water Star?

The is a member of the Nine Stars embodying the planet [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercury Mercury]. He is also in charge of the Department of Water.

Sun Wukong went up to Dark Vastness Palace to seek the help of the Water Star and the Department of Water after being defeated by the Single Horned Rhinoceros King. The Water Star dropped half the water of the yellow river on Golden Pouch Cave, but the Rhinoceros King used the Diamond Cutter to repel it away from him.

The Water Star carries a vase which can hold the entire contents of the Yellow River, though they usually only carry half. The water cannot be put back in the vase after being poured out.
